author: Thomas Watson Steen
html:
As far as I can see, it works great with Euros. Try for example "[123 DKK in EUR](http://www.google.com/search?q=123+DKK+in+EUR)".

But for some reason I do not see the auto complete working with currency conversion directly in the browser :(
